_readme: CLEWs country catalog — the CLEWs mirror of the OG universal installer's repos.json.
Each entry names a repo that ships portable MUIO cases; per-country details live in
countries/<ISO3>.json (overlay manifests, hosted here until the clews-country.json
spec migrates into the country repos themselves — see clews/README.md).
iso3 is the join key for matching a CLEWs country to its OG model (og-<iso3>).

repos.description: Philippines CLEWs country model (portable MUIO cases, v12 lineage)
